description.GyroEnabled: Rotate the gameplay camera directly with the controller gyroscope.
description.SensitivityX: Degrees of horizontal camera rotation per degree of controller rotation.
description.SensitivityY: Degrees of vertical camera rotation per degree of controller rotation.
description.AltFireMultiplier: Multiply gyro sensitivity during Alt-Fire, replacing the aim multiplier.
description.GyroSpace:
Player Space: combines turning and rolling according to controller tilt; up/down aiming follows the controller’s pitch.

Local Yaw: turn around the controller’s own up axis to aim left/right.

Local Roll: roll the controller like a steering wheel to aim left/right.

World Space: left/right rotation follows gravity’s vertical axis; up/down aiming uses an axis parallel to the ground.
description.ActivationButton: Button used to activate or suspend the gyroscope.
description.DisableWhileRightStick: Temporarily suspend gyro while moving the right stick.
description.AutomaticCalibration: Estimate gyro drift automatically. Leave off to preserve deliberate slow movement.
description.Smoothing: Reduce small-motion jitter. Higher levels smooth more; fast turns remain immediate.
description.Acceleration: Increase sensitivity during fast turns. Low: up to 1.5x; Medium: 2x; High: 3x. Slow aiming keeps the base sensitivity.
description.FlickStick: Push the right stick toward a direction to turn horizontally, then rotate it around the edge to keep turning. Use gyro for vertical aiming. Hip-fire Only restores normal stick aiming during aim and Alt-Fire.
description.FlickSpinDurationMs: Duration of the initial flick rotation. 0 ms turns instantly. Circular stick movement remains immediate.
calibration.steamHelp: Steam Input handles gyro calibration for this controller. Use Steam controller settings to recalibrate. The mod adds no manual or automatic bias correction.
description.GyroButton: Button used to activate or suspend the gyroscope.
description.GyroTouchpad: Touch the selected touchpad to activate or suspend the gyroscope.
description.GyroStickSensor: Touch the top of the selected stick to activate or suspend the gyroscope. No click is needed.
description.GyroGripSensor: Hold the selected grip sensor to activate or suspend the gyroscope.
description.GyroStick: Tilt the selected stick to activate or suspend the gyroscope.
